name: Baroda Critical Text
description: The reconstructed text published by the Oriental Institute, Baroda (1960–75), as digitised in GRETIL.

name: Traditional Text (Vulgate, southern recension)
description: The longer traditional text, 7 kāṇḍas in 645 sargas, as transcribed on Sanskrit Wikisource. Many verses are written with sandhi undone (जनः च शूद्रो अपि), as in the source.
